args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with 18% error rate after deploy. Rolled back to previous healthy release v2.3.0 in all regions. Monitoring to confirm recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the rollback.

4. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate back down to 0.2%.

Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy, but it was a staging release, so it was not a candidate for rollback.
